425: Ginko employs himself as a Mushi master (mushi-shi), traveling from place to place to research Mushi and aid people suffering from problems caused by them.
4071: Adashino is the doctor of a seaside village whom Ginko occasionally visits to sell Mushi-related items to. His hobby is collecting such items and keeps them in a shed behind his home.
5167: Nui is a Mushishi and the narrator of the anime series. Her voice can be heard in many episodes. Nui's appearance is very similar to the series' protagonist Ginko. Due to her exposure to the Ginko Mushi, she has white hair and only her left eye (which has turned green).
9972: A blacksmith whose dreams become reality seeks Ginko's help. He appears in episode #4, The Pillow Lane.
13714: Tanyuu is the fourth and current Scribe of the Karibusa family. A Karibusa Scribe is a person with a special coal-like birthmark. The birthmark contains a type of Mushi called The Forbidden Mushi. The curse is located on her right leg.
16808: Kisuke appears in episode 14, "Inside the Cage". He is unable to escape a bamboo forest due to Mushi that take the shape of mysterious white bamboo. He is Setsu's husband and the father of her child.
16809: Setsu appears in episode 14, "Inside the Cage." Mysteriously, she was born as a bamboo shoot, but grew as a normal human - outside of surviving only on the water of the white bamboo, that is. She is what they call an oni-ko, the daughter of a human and a mushi.
16810: Miharu appears in episode 15, "Pretense of Spring". He is a young boy with the ability to see Mushi, by which he is absolutely fascinated. Of course, this ability never fails to make his sister, Suzu, worry, and for good reason.
16811: Suzu is a character who lives with her younger brother, Miharu, in a small mountain house on the outskirts of a village. Suzu is a young lady, with pale skin, dark eyes, and long black hair kept in a loose braid.
16879: Sayo appears in episode 16, "Sunrise Serpent." She has been having trouble sleeping and suffers strange memory loss with each passing day... due to the infection of a snake-like mushi that lives in shadows and feeds on memories.
16880: Kaji appears in episode 16, "Sunrise Serpent." He enlists the help of Ginko to get to the bottom of his mother's ever-worsening memory problems.
16881: Ito appears in episode 17, "Pickers of Empty Cocoons." Due to her ability to see Mushi, she is apprenticed at a young age by a man who uses a particular mushi's ability to pass through space. However, an unfortunate turn of fate traps her in the world of these mushi.
16882: Aya is a character who lives alone in the mountain forest, crafting letter carriers for Mushishi. Aya has dark eyes and wears her hair short, with her bangs brushed to her right. She wears dull kimono and has a rather disheveled appearance after the disappearance of Ito.
16884: Jiisama appears in episode 17, "Pickers of Empty Cocoons." He is able to use a particular type of mushi cocoons to deliver letters. Despite years of experience in the field, he was unable to protect his two young apprentices, Ito and Aya, from tragedy at the hands of these mushi.
16886: Kai appears in episode 18, "Clothes that Embrace the Mountain." He leaves home to become an artist - he achieves success quickly. However, because of this, he neglects his family until it is too late to return to them.
16887: Toyo appears in episode 18, "Clothes that Embrace the Mountain." She is Kai's niece. She suffers from a disability and develops slowly - a problem some local mushi may be able to fix.
17060: Fuki appears in episode 19, "String from the Sky." She has the ability to see Mushi, though she doesn't realize what they are; as a result, others in the town consider her to be strange.
17061: Seijiro appears in episode 19, "String from the Sky." He hires Fuki as a nurse to care for his baby sister and ends up falling in love with her. This is complicated, though, by the fact that she tends to disappear.
17128: Tama Minai is a Mushishi who is committed to protecting the Scribe of the Karibusa family. Tama's ancestor sealed The Forbidden Mushi into the Karibusa Family. The Mushi has since then been passed on to each member of the family in the form of a birthmark.
17355: Watahiko appears in episode 21, "Cotton Changeling." Watahiko was born to Aki and Yasuke as a strange green goo. When it vanished, a baby was found in its place after some time. Then another, and another... all identical, all named "Watahiko.
17356: Aki appears in episode 21, "Cotton Changeling." She was devastated when her baby turned out to be something other than human, and so willingly accepted the disguised mushi Watahiko as her sons.
17357: Yasuke appears in episode 21, "Cotton Changeling." He is slightly less accepting of Watahiko's bizarre birth, and so contacts Ginko when the situation takes a turn for he worse.
17358: Mio appears in episode 22, "Shrine in the Sea." Using the power of a mushi found at the bottom of the sea, Mio gave birth to her deceased mother and raised the replica as a daughter. The decision weighs on her conscience, however...
17359: Isana appears in episode 22, "Shrine in the Sea." She is Mio's daughter... and her mother. As Mana, she willingly sacrificed her time to the mushi at the bottom of the sea and was reborn as her daughter's daughter.
19464: When she was a little girl she couldn't see, but when her father returned from his travels, she regained her sight. After her sight returned, she began having visions.
19708: Koro appears in episode seven and has a strange habit of pursuing rainbows just like his father used to do.
23764: Shinra Ioroi is a boy whose left hand is like a god's. He has lived alone in the mountains ever since his grandmother, Renzu Ioroi, died. Shinra has the ability to create life by drawing with his left hand.
23765: Renzu Ioroi is Shinra Ioroi's grandmother. When she was a child, she drank Kouki, which should have made her a Mushi, but the ritual was interrupted, causing half of her soul to become trapped in limbo between the human and Mushi world.
23796: Sui is the youngest daughter in her family. Six months ago, she contracted a disease, making her eyes sensitive to light. Unable to find the cause nor a cure, her family sent her to relatives they knew and kept her in a storage shed in complete darkness.
23845: A boy who lost his hearing and has four mysterious horns on his head. He lives with his grandmother since his mother death who had the same horns as Maho.
23846: A strange girl with green hair who lives near the travelling swamp.
23870: A boy who is friends with Akoya and asks Ginko for help in rescuing her.
23871: Akoya was once a sad girl who has been good friend with Magi. But suddenly she started to act strange and everyday she would suddenly grow old and only in the morning turn back to her old self.
24126: Isaza is a member of the traveling Watari, always staying near the "river of light".
24127: Taku is a man living near the mountain on which the mushi sometimes gather.
24128: A women who makes inkstones. Once she had a fiance but he died afer he got a inkstone that she made.
24129: A young girl living in the village who takes an interest in Shirou after he helped her.
24130: Shirou a man who lost his wife and has been waiting for her return for 2 and half years.
24131: Shirou's wife. She has disappeared in the fog after she had a fight with him.
26274: A girl whose broken, haunting voice attracts a mushi called Yasabi to her village, which paralyzes its residents. She became aware of the effect of her voice at an early age, and vowed to never speak again.
36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
44785: Maho's mother who appears in the third episode of the first season of Mushishi.
168343: A brewery master who wishes to replicate his father's golden sake.
168346: A woman with striking beauty that lacks all five senses.
168347: A gardener who makes medicine which seems to heal any illness.
168349: The village elder, who is for some reason hated by Sakichi.
168351: A young girl who meets Ginko, while trying to buy medicine for her ill mother.
168353: After his younger sister died in the lake, Toki seemed to have snow following him around...
168354: Sakichi and his daughter, Mina, appear in Episode 2, "The Warbling Sea Shell." They live by the sea, but suspiciously not in the nearby seaside village.
168355: A young woman, who seems to fall in love easily. After experiencing heartbreak she becomes very passive and withdrawn.
168356: He seems to be hiding a secret.
168357: A young sailor who has developed a connection to a flock of bird-type mushi able to create wind.
168358: A young, simple girl who lives near a fishing village by the sea. She and her father, Sakichi, appear in Episode 2, "The Warbling Sea Shell." Mina appears to be a friendly child, but without anyone to talk to.
168359: A man of seemingly boundless energy who helps Ginko when he falls unconscious on a snowy mountain.
168387: Rokusuke's father. He once found a mushishi gathering plants in the woods and drank some of their golden sake, forever trying to reproduce its fine notes as a sake brewer.
